actions.action: Move plant 2-3 metres back from the window
Alternatively hang a sheer curtain between plant and glass
Check whether the base of the dead leaves is soft or mushy (crown rot)
Water at soil level, avoiding the center of the rosette
Check top 2-3 cm of soil before watering, then water thoroughly and let drain
Empty standing water from the saucer
Use rainwater, filtered water, or tap water left out overnight
Slide plant out of pot and inspect roots
If roots are damaged, trim them and repot in fresh well-draining mix
Trim dead leaves at the base

reason: The answer blames too much direct sun, the opposite of the confirmed lack of light, so its main advice to move the plant further from the window would cut its light even more and delay the fix of moving it outside.
